item.title: Habitat Network — Ancient Semi-Natural Woodland source files
item.subtitle: Biodiversity & Habitats / Ulster Wildlife
item.description: Spatial extent of ancient semi-natural woodland habitat across Northern Ireland, classified into Existing Habitat, Associated Habitats, Network Enhancement Zones, Fragmentation Action Zones and Network Expansion Zones. Part of the Nature Recovery NI habitat-network mapping project published by Ulster Wildlife on Open Data NI.

references.label: Open Data NI — Ancient Semi-Natural Woodland Habitat Network
